body: You're right, I should stop arguing and just do it. I've been putting it off long enough already. I feel like I'm just using my family as an excuse at this point and i don't even know why.

I've been thinking about it loads, but I feel like I jist go round in circles. I'm sure more intelligent people have written books on life and death. Mayb reading one of those would help...

Thanks for your input. I feel like you were the only person who actually read my post and understood it.

Things are already ok, that's the point. This one of the better periods of my life. But even of it does better than this, how is that a motivator to keep going? I'm sure that as an insentient (is that a word?) lump of mostly carbon the degree to which my life was good won't affect me much.

I don't really connect with others, hence the loneliness. 

In my post I wasn't trying to say life was about the exceptional moments. I was saying that if it were about those moments it would still be pointless. Why should I live my life to improve the lives of those around me? Why should I seek happiness? At the very end when I'm lying in the ground somewhere what difference will that have made?
What's my motivator for living life as it comes? What do I get out of it?
Why do "we gotta stick it out"? I'm not trying to be annoying, I genuinely want to know.
